correctness.rationale: All-order local covariance identity proved by enumerating same-vertex, adjacent and nonadjacent indicator pairs. The exact energy decomposition proves strict maximality of the path for every n>=4. The star is uniquely minimal for n>=7 by a uniform nonstar degree bound and for n=4..6 by exhaustive small-tree degree classification. Independent exact orientation enumeration verifies all labeled trees n<=6; all labeled tree shapes n<=8 pass formula and extremal checks.

value.rationale: The all-order sharp unique extremizers quantify the joint input/output terminal count fluctuations in randomly oriented tree networks. The covariance becomes positive on paths for n>=5 but remains negative on stars, with exact n-dependent bounds; the degree-energy proof supplies a structural inequality, not a routine isolated moment.
